subject.test: preserves compiler, visible-view, validation, and reconstruction identities

method.constrainedCondition: 13 CPU burners with the test process at nice 15

taskProviderTimingMs.measurement: five tasks per category and provider; values summarize each call kind within that stratum

historicalComparison.finding: No material slowdown relative to alpha.3 or the introducing commit was observed.

hypotheses.name: post-alpha3-canonicalization-regression
hypotheses.evidence: Current warm timing is not slower than alpha.3 or the introducing commit.

hypotheses.name: typegraph-repository-or-snapshot-regression
hypotheses.evidence: Repository creation and snapshot together consumed about 1.1 percent of a representative run.

hypotheses.name: parallel-paired-calls-reduce-wall-time
hypotheses.evidence: A temporary Promise.all experiment remained CPU-bound and did not materially reduce clean wall time.

hypotheses.name: uncalibrated-aggregate-timeout
hypotheses.evidence: The test was introduced with the full 60-assignment matrix and a fixed 20-second timeout; controlled contention approaches the bound and hosted runs are censored by it.

classification.rootCause: The anti-hang timeout was fixed at 20 seconds without a measured contention margin for a CPU-bound 240-call identity matrix.

prospectiveCorrection.derivation: Round up beyond twice the measured constrained maximum of 17446.546 ms.
